name: Deployment Dashboard
secret_hint: Debug configuration and admin credentials must never be reachable by a low-privilege or anonymous caller.
policy: Viewing releases and deployments requires a signed-in user; creating or deleting deployments is admin-only. Session tokens, debug or configuration endpoints must not be reachable by non-admins, and no password, token or credential may ever appear in a response to a non-admin. The admin password must come from the DEPLOY_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable, never a hardcoded value.
